key_points: Halliburton signed MOUs with Eneva and WESCA to expand Venezuela oil and gas development.
Several outlets highlight HAL as a defense sector pick, but this appears to be confusion with another HAL ticker and is likely noise.
Stock fell 1.62% on Sep 22, closing at $32.85, reflecting short‑term market pressure.
Analysts (Citi, Goldman Sachs) retain Buy ratings, citing improving execution.
Valuation discussions label HAL as a value stock with modest undervaluation per some models.
